configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Google Test suite against the SHARED library in ../EventProp.C/build. Run the release preset there first. Required for parity tests.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Requires the asan preset in ../EventProp.C (same ENABLE_ASAN=ON, Debug) so library and tests are instrumented together. On macOS the library is STATIC there. On Linux add leak detection at run time: ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 ctest --preset asan. It must not go in a preset — gtest_discover_tests runs the binary at build time, inherits preset environment, and macOS ASan aborts on detect_leaks.
